tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground under the sky layer. shadcn neutral.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text on background, card, popover, muted, accent and sun-soft.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Opaque surface for every block that sits on the sky: DayCard, chart, compare table, map frame, inputs.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Search suggestions, map popup, chart tooltip.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Isobar blue. Primary button, pressed compare toggle, active city chip, map marker, chart now-line. As text: on background, card and muted (8:1 light, 9:1 dark).

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: shadcn secondary button fill.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: StatusMessage, map skeleton, disabled fields.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text: lows, captions, admin region in suggestions. Holds 4.5:1 on background, card, muted, accent and sun-soft in both themes. Darker than shadcn neutral (#737373 is 4.4:1 on muted).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover surface and the highlighted suggestion (shadcn semantics: a hover surface, not the brand colour). Tinted toward primary so the active option is visible.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Kept for shadcn primitives (aria-invalid). The app has no destructive actions; failures use StatusMessage on muted.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: table rows, popover edge, top of the compare header. Decorative, not a control boundary.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons and city chips: 3:1 on card in both themes.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring colour, solid (shadcn's 50% grey ring is under 3:1).

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Weekend marker fill only (the cover, the Saturday/Sunday dot). Never text; text on it is on-sun.

tokens.name: on-sun
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a sun fill.

tokens.name: sun-soft
tokens.usage: Weekend surfaces: WeekendSummary, Saturday and Sunday DayCards, compare table day rows.

tokens.name: sun-ink
tokens.usage: Weekend text (the «Вихідні» label, Сб/Нд names) on sun-soft, card or background.

tokens.name: comfort-good
tokens.usage: Comfort badge fill, score 70–100 (FR-COMFORT-04). The only strong fill of the three, so good days are what the eye finds first.

tokens.name: on-comfort-good
tokens.usage: Number, word and meter on comfort-good (5.4:1 light, 9.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: comfort-fair
tokens.usage: Comfort badge fill, score 40–69.

tokens.name: on-comfort-fair
tokens.usage: Number, word and meter on comfort-fair (7.5:1 light, 8.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: comfort-poor
tokens.usage: Comfort badge fill, score 0–39. Fair and poor are close in lightness: the 1–3 bar meter and the number carry the tier, never hue alone.

tokens.name: on-comfort-poor
tokens.usage: Number, word and meter on comfort-poor (6.4:1 light, 8.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: sky-day-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the day sky gradient (FR-ANIM-01/02). Also water on the map stand-in.

tokens.name: sky-day-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the day sky gradient.

tokens.name: sky-night-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the night sky gradient. The light-theme night is a dusk slate so dark text still reads.

tokens.name: sky-night-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the night sky gradient.

tokens.name: sky-ink
tokens.usage: Text placed directly on the sky: top bar, empty-state title, footer. 9:1 or better on every sky stop in both themes.

tokens.name: sky-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text directly on the sky (tagline, footer credits): 4.6:1 or better on every sky stop.

tokens.name: rain
tokens.usage: Rain streaks in the sky layer. Decorative.

tokens.name: snow
tokens.usage: Snowflakes in the sky layer. Decorative.

tokens.name: cloud
tokens.usage: Drifting cloud shapes in the sky layer. Decorative.

tokens.name: chart-temp
tokens.usage: Hourly temperature line and its now-dot (FR-FORECAST-03): 4.5:1 on card light, 8:1 dark.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Horizontal chart gridlines.

tokens.name: chart-now
tokens.usage: Dashed vertical line at the current hour.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Geologica (Google Fonts, Latin + Cyrillic): numbers read at a glance and the one headline.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: Weekend comfort score in WeekendSummary (FR-COMFORT-05). One per view.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Empty-state headline (FR-SHELL-03). The page's only h1.

styles.name: temp
styles.usage: Day high in DayCard and CompareTable.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Product name in the top bar (FR-SHELL-01). No logo mark exists.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Onest (Google Fonts, Latin + Cyrillic). Numbers that line up add tabular-nums.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings, city names in compare headers and the map popup.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Сухо й сонячно, вітер слабкий, але вечори холодні.
styles.usage: Running text: comfort rationale, empty-state line, jokes.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Buttons, chips, suggestion names, the clock.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Weekday names, the «Вихідні» kicker, compare day rows, badge numbers.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Lows, precipitation and wind, chart ticks, sunrise/sunset, footer credits.

styles.name: input
styles.usage: The city search field. 16px keeps iOS Safari from zooming on focus.

styles.name: coord
styles.usage: Rounded coordinates of a clicked map point (FR-MAP-03).

spacing.note: 4px base. Gutters grow with the breakpoints: space-4, space-6, space-8.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; between badge parts.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls; between chips; search row gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: DayCard column gap and vertical padding; between related rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Grid column gap; tablet gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop gutter; between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state hero distance from the top bar.

radius.note: shadcn's 0.625rem scale. Soft, never round, except chips and the marker.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Comfort badges, attribution corner.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, suggestion rows, map popup.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards: DayCard, chart, compare table, map frame, popover, StatusMessage.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: WeekendSummary and the empty-state search panel: the two blocks that lead.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: City chips, map marker.

shadow.note: Cards are opaque and lifted off the sky; in dark a 1px ring replaces the shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Every card on the sky.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Suggestions list, map popup, chart tooltip.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every interactive element (NFR-A11Y-01): a 2px page-colour gap, then 2px solid primary.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, city chips, large comfort badge.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Search input and «Моє місцезнаходження»: the touch-first pair.

tokens.name: badge-h
tokens.usage: Comfort badge in DayCard and CompareTable.

tokens.name: icon-xs
tokens.usage: Icons inline with caption text (precipitation, wind, chip close).

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons and the search field.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: StatusMessage icon.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Condition icon in DayCard.

tokens.name: map-h-sm
tokens.usage: Map and its skeleton below bp-md.

tokens.name: map-h
tokens.usage: Map and its skeleton from bp-md.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the three-column grid.

breakpoint.note: FR-SHELL-02. In Tailwind 4 these are md: (768) and xl: (1280); don't use lg: (1024) for layout.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Two columns from here.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Three columns from here.

zIndex.note: Leaflet uses 400 for panes and 1000 for controls; the app's overlays sit above them.

tokens.name: z-sky
tokens.usage: The fixed sky layer.

tokens.name: z-content
tokens.usage: The page content above the sky.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: Top bar.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Search suggestions; must clear the map's controls.
